purpose: Prevent mixed Species/Innate/Elementalist and environment Ability datasets from being treated as automatic biology ownership while preserving source-backed Species/Form/Adaptation capability routes.

sources.governed_next_action: species/innate ownership classification and cross-file identity reconciliation

shapeshifter_reconciliation.pairing_rule: Name similarity, tier, position and shared branch are review hints only. Pairing requires exact source evidence or an explicitly governed owner-delegated recommendation with rationale, alternatives, confidence and reversibility.

classification_rules: A Species prerequisite or Species Perk label establishes eligibility/source ownership, not necessarily anatomy or physiology.
Innate in a tree name is not sufficient to decide whether a capability is biological, psychic, magical, technological, archetypal or mixed.
Elementalist rows remain Ability-domain content unless an explicit Species/Form/body rule binds them biologically.
Environment-Based Ability Collection rows are contextual/learned by default for routing purposes; biological Adaptation requires explicit body/Species/Form evidence.
A biological-looking Ability name does not establish exact mechanics, compatibility, permanence, anatomy or identity.
Source absence stays explicit; no inferred organ, limb, sense, speed, resistance, vulnerability, lifespan or environmental tolerance is promoted as source fact.
Runtime transformation or Adaptation state is not the reusable Ability/Species/Form Definition.

routing_outputs.source_backed_species_gated_ability: Ability system plus PPIA-05 eligibility relation
routing_outputs.learned_or_contextual_environment_abilit: Ability system; environment authoring routes to PPIA-08/PPIA-12
routing_outputs.balance_or_pricing_interpretation: PPIA-11 unless already explicit source fact

promotion_boundary: This routing contract classifies evidence and owning surfaces only. It does not create canonical Species/Form Definitions, merge Shapeshifter pricing rows, invent biology, mutate source CSVs/PDFs, or authorize application runtime/release operations.
